description.en: South Dakota is a landlocked state in the Upper Midwest region of the United States. It is also part of the Great Plains.
description.zh-CN: 南達科他州，簡稱南達州，是美國中西部平原上地勢較高的一州，過去曾是美國印地安人蘇族中拉科他族的聚落所在。南達科他州在1889年11月2日加入美國聯邦，也是在同一天被命名的。

photo.alt: Eastern (downstream) side of the Beaver Creek Bridge, which carries Highway 87 over Beaver Creek near Hot Springs in Custer County, South Dakota, United States. Built in 1929 in the present boundaries of Wind Cave National Park, the bridge is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
